tolerance.notes: coef_rel/coef_abs/fitted_abs_per_sd are the Rust fit_ols_regression tolerance; sql_point_abs covers the residual-model component ts_forecast_exog_by adds on top of the regression effect, so the SQL-level point forecast is compared against expected_regression with a much looser bound.

parameters.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(1), one shared stream across all 8 cases in fixed order
parameters.intercept_convention: coef[0] is the intercept; coef[1:] are the betas in column order of X
parameters.x_layout: X is stored column-major: X[j] is regressor j over all n observations
